description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chazz Surratt has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Surratt is unable to go on a short week for Seattle.
items.title: Chazz Surratt (calf) ruled out Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Drake Thomas has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Thomas is unable to go on a short week. Tyrice Knight will start for Thomas.
items.title: Drake Thomas (ankle) ruled out Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Charbonnet remains hopeful to make his season debut next week against the Chiefs.
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) ruled out for Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Riley Moss is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Moss was limited in practice all week. Pat Surtain II and Talanoa Hufanga were both ruled out.
items.title: Riley Moss (ribs) listed questionable for Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Caleb Williams was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: This confirms what Ben Johnson told reporters earlier in the day on Wednesday. Williams will have a chance to return for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) officially logs full practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyler Gordon was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyle Monangai did not practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Pat Surtain II (ankle) has been ruled out for the Broncos contest against the Seahawks on Thursday due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Surtain will miss yet another game, but with the Bronco's having a mini bye week, hopefully he can return for Week 7. Denver will have to make it work without him.
